title: Senior RFIC Validation Engineer
desc:
Job Description:
As a Sr. RFIC Validation Engineer in mmwave/RF IC group, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of RF & mmwave products (such as beamformers, up/downconverters, LNAs, PAs, etc.) through comprehensive final test implementation. You will be responsible for the ATE final test development of mmWave/RF projects and be the leading force in the development cycle of Axiro’s innovative test solutions.
Primary Responsibilities:
Delivering high-quality test solutions for complex RF/mmWave front-end ICs.
Developing and implementing test plans, test cases, and test procedures based on RF/mmwave product specifications and requirements.
Designing and executing test setups using automated test equipment (ATE), probe stations, oscilloscopes, and other testing tools.
Programming and scripting in languages such as Python, C, or C++ to automate test processes and analyze test data.
Conducting thorough test validation and verification to ensure accurate and reliable testing results.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams including design engineers, manufacturing teams, and quality assurance (QA) teams to address technical issues and optimize testing processes.
Analyzing test results, identifying trends, troubleshooting issues, and generating detailed test reports and documentation.
Planning and overseeing the loadboard hardware development for RF & mmwave IC products.
Staying updated with industry trends, advancements, and best practices in semiconductor testing methodologies.
Qualifications:
Test Engineer with 3+ Years experience developing hardware and software at Wafer Sort and Final Test for RF & mmwave IC products.
Experience using Advantest 93k, Teradyne MicroFlex, and other establish automated tester solutions.
Previous experience and product track record with high performance RFIC test development (experience on beamformer IC is a big plus).
Fundamental RF knowledge including main RF performance specifications such as Gain, Return loss, NF, P1dB, IP3, ACPR, EVM, etc.
Experience using I2C, I3C, and SPI protocol.
Understand procedures such as GR&R, HTOL, Characterization.
Prior experience leading external contractors for test hardware and software development.
Self-starter, motivated, takes initiative, and able to work independently.
